decisions.reason: The coupling protection cap is a low-cost accessory that builds directly on the firm's coupling and trailer know-how and supports after-sales revenue, so there is little reason to drop it despite limited website visibility.
The box trailer series sits at the core of the firm's production knowledge and it survived the 2019 portfolio cleanup, so the firm can read its market feedback well and keep improving it.
High covers complement the retained box trailers, use familiar materials and processes, and sell through existing channels, so the firm has the related knowledge to keep developing them.
